description: Retrieve only metadata for a blob without downloading content. Useful for checking properties.
embedding_description: Retrieve only metadata for a blob without downloading content. Use to check size, mime type, filenames, or custom tags before retrieval. Provide namespace and blob_id and receive metadata without transferring content bytes.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Blob metadata including size, type, and custom attributes
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Retrieving metadata for a blob without downloading content
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFoundError: Blob with given ID does not exist. StorageError: Failed to read metadata from filesystem. PermissionError: Insufficient permissions to read from storage.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For not found: verify blob_id is correct and blob exists. For storage errors: check filesystem health. For permission errors: verify storage directory permissions.
